G2617.kort: I shame, disgrace, put to utter confusion
G2617.lang: I shame, disgrace, bring to shame, put to utter confusion, frustrate.

G2621.lang: I recline (at table); more often: I keep my bed, am lying ill (in bed).

G2622.lang: I break in pieces, break up.

G2629.lang: I cut up, cut in pieces, mangle, wound.

G2631.lang: punishment following condemnation, penal servitude, penalty.

G2632.lang: I condemn, judge worthy of punishment.

G2634.lang: I exercise authority over, overpower, master.

G2637.lang: slanderous, back-biting; subst: a railer, defamer.

G2638.kort: I seize tight hold of, overtake, comprehend
G2638.lang: (a) I seize tight hold of, arrest, catch, capture, appropriate, (b) I overtake, (c) mid. aor: I perceived, comprehended.

G2641.lang: I leave behind, desert, abandon, forsake; I leave remaining, reserve.

G2647.kort: I break up, overthrow, unharness, find a lodging
G2647.lang: (lit: I loosen thoroughly), (a) trans: I break up, overthrow, destroy, both lit. and met., (b) I unyoke, unharness a carriage horse or pack animal; hence: I put up, lodge, find a lodging.

G2648.lang: I understand, take in a fact about, consider carefully.

G2657.lang: I take note of, perceive, consider carefully, discern, detect, make account of.

G2658.kort: I come down, arrive at, reach
G2658.lang: (a) I come down, either from high land to lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to the coast; hence met: I arrive at, reach (my destination), (b) of property: I come down (descend) by inheritance to an heir.

G2662.lang: I trample down, trample under foot (lit. and met.), spurn.

G2665.lang: (lit: that which is spread out downwards, that which hangs down), a curtain, veil, of that which separated the Holy of Holies from the outer parts of the temple at Jerusalem, also of an outer curtain at the entrance to the Holy Place in the same temple.

G2666.lang: I drink down, swallow, devour, destroy, consume.

G2670.kort: I sink in the sea, am drowned
G2670.lang: I sink in the sea, pass: I drown, am submerged.

G2673.kort: I bring to naught, sever, abolish
G2673.lang: (a) I make idle (inactive), make of no effect, annul, abolish, bring to naught, (b) I discharge, sever, separate from.

G2675.lang: (a) I fit (join) together; met: I compact together, (b) act. and mid: I prepare, perfect, for his (its) full destination or use, bring into its proper condition (whether for the first time, or after a lapse).

G2679.lang: I dig down under, demolish, undermine.

G2680.lang: I build, construct, prepare, make ready.

G2681.lang: I encamp, take up my quarters, tabernacle, pitch my tent, dwell.

G2693.lang: I strew or spread over; I lay low, overthrow.

G2698.lang: (a) I lay down, deposit, (b) mid: I lay down or deposit a favor, with the view of receiving one in return, seek favor.

G2706.lang: I despise, scorn, and show it by active insult, disregard.

G2710.lang: I use to the full, use up.

G2714.lang: before the face of, over against.

G2716.lang: I effect by labor, achieve, work out, bring about.

G2719.kort: I eat till it is finished
G2719.lang: I eat up, eat till it is finished, devour, squander, annoy, injure.

G2722.lang: (a) I hold fast, bind, arrest, (b) I take possession of, lay hold of, (c) I hold back, detain, restrain, (d) I hold a ship, keep its head.

G2729.kort: I prevail against, overpower, am able
G2729.lang: I prevail against, overpower, get the upper hand.

G2730.kort: I dwell in, settle in, inhabit
G2730.lang: I dwell in, settle in, am established in (permanently), inhabit.

G2736.lang: (a) down, below, also: downwards, (b) lower, under, less, of a length of time.

G2745.lang: a boasting; a ground of boasting (glorying, exultation).

G2746.lang: the act of boasting, glorying, exultation.

G2747.lang: Cenchreae, the port of Corinth on the Saronic Gulf.

G2749.lang: I lie, recline, am placed, am laid, set, specially appointed, destined.

G2750.lang: a kind of girdle made of cords; a bandage, grave clothes.

G2751.kort: I shear, cut the hair of
G2751.lang: I shear, cut the hair of; mid: I cut my own hair, have my hair cut.

G2756.lang: (a) empty, (b) met: empty (in moral content), vain, ineffective, foolish, worthless, (c) false, unreal, pretentious, hollow.

G2758.kort: I empty, deprive of content, make unreal
G2758.lang: (a) I empty, (b) I deprive of content, make unreal.

G2759.lang: a sting, goad; met: of death.

G2760.lang: a centurion, an officer commanding about a hundred infantry in the Roman army.

G2762.lang: a little hook, an apostrophe on letters of the alphabet, distinguishing them from other little letters, or a separation stroke between letters.

G2770.lang: I gain, acquire, win (over), avoid loss.

G2772.lang: a small coin; plur: small change.

G2773.lang: properly: a changer of large into smaller coins, a money-changer.

G2776.lang: (a) the head, (b) met: a corner stone, uniting two walls; head, ruler, lord.

G2779.lang: a garden, any place planted with trees and herbs.

G2785.lang: a sea monster, huge sea fish, whale.

G2786.lang: Cephas (Aramaic for rock), the new name given to Simon Peter, the apostle.

G2787.lang: (properly: a wooden box, hence) the Ark, in which Noah sailed; the Ark of the Covenant.

G2789.lang: intrans. and trans: I play on the harp, I harp, with acc. of the tune.

G2793.lang: I am in danger or peril.

G2795.lang: I set in motion, move, remove, excite, stir up.

G2798.lang: a young tender shoot, then: a branch; met: of descendants.

G2799.lang: I weep, weep for, mourn, lament.

G2815.lang: Clement, a fellow-worker of Paul in Rome.

G2816.lang: I inherit, obtain (possess) by inheritance, acquire.

G2817.lang: an inheritance, an heritage, regularly the gift of God to His chosen people, in the Old Testament: the Promised Land, in NT a possession viewed in one sense as present, in another as future; a share, participation.

G2819.lang: (a) a lot, (b) a portion assigned; hence: a portion of the people of God assigned to one's care, a congregation.

G2821.lang: a calling, invitation; in the NT, always of a divine call.

G2822.lang: called, invited, summoned by God to an office or to salvation.

G2824.lang: a small geographical division, district, or territory.

G2825.lang: a couch, bed, portable bed or mat, a couch for reclining at meals, possibly also a bier.

G2827.kort: I rest, recline, make to yield
G2827.lang: trans: I rest, recline; I bend, incline; I cause to give ground, make to yield; intrans: I decline, approach my end.

G2832.lang: Clopas, husband of one Mary, who stood by the cross.

G2835.lang: a "quadrans," the smallest Roman copper coin, a quarter of an "as," the sixteenth part of a "sesterius".

G2836.lang: belly, abdomen, heart, a general term covering any organ in the abdomen, e.g. stomach, womb; met: the inner man.

G2837.lang: I fall asleep, am asleep, sometimes of the sleep of death.

G2839.lang: (a) common, shared, (b) Hebraistic use: profane; dirty, unclean, unwashed.

G2840.kort: I make unclean, regard as unclean
G2840.lang: I make unclean, pollute, desecrate, mid: I regard (treat) as unclean.

G2841.kort: I share, communicate, have fellowship with
G2841.lang: (a) I share, communicate, contribute, impart, (b) I share in, have a share of, have fellowship with.

G2842.lang: (lit: partnership) (a) contributory help, participation, (b) sharing in, communion, (c) spiritual fellowship, a fellowship in the spirit.

G2845.lang: (a) a bed, (b) a marriage bed; plur: repeated (immoral) sexual intercourse.

G2847.lang: crimson, scarlet, dyed with Kermes (coccum), the female coccus of the Kermes oak.

G2851.lang: chastisement, punishment, torment, perhaps with the idea of deprivation.

G2852.kort: I strike with the fist, maltreat
G2852.lang: I strike with the fist, buffet; hence: I mistreat violently.

G2853.kort: I glue, cleave, keep company with
G2853.lang: (lit: I glue); hence: mid. and pass: I join myself closely, cleave, adhere (to), I keep company (with), of friendly intercourse.

G2855.lang: a money-changer, who changed heathen into Jewish money, for payment into the Temple treasury.

G2856.lang: (lit: I maim, mutilate), I cut short, shorten, abbreviate.

G2857.lang: Colossae, a town of the Roman province Asia, in the Lycus valley, near Laodicea and Hierapolis.

G2859.kort: bosom, bosom of a garment, a bay, gulf
G2859.lang: (a) sing. and plur: bosom; (sinus) the overhanging fold of the garment used as a pocket, (b) a bay, gulf.

G2861.lang: (lit: a diving or swimming place), a pool.

G2863.lang: I wear the hair long, allow the hair to grow out.

G2865.lang: (a) act: I convey, bring, carry, (b) mid: I receive back, receive what has belonged to myself but has been lost, or else promised but kept back, or: I get what has come to be my own by earning, recover.
